name: Vodafone Idea Ltd
title: Vodafone Idea Ltd - 532822 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Vi's Q4 FY26 is a capex-led recovery story, but the headline profit is an AGR one-off (Rs 55,622 Cr exceptional gain); cash EBITDA grew only 4.8% and FY26 cash EBITDA was flat at Rs 9,217 Cr.

capex.quote: Our capex intensity, as we have laid out our plan for the next three years is Rs. 45,000 Crores that absolutely remains intact and we are on track.

triggers.label: AGR dues cut to Rs 64,046 Cr
triggers.quote: Our AGR dues have been finalised at Rs 64,046 Crore as of December 31, 2025 — a reduction from the earlier frozen figure of Rs 87,695 Crore.

triggers.label: Customer ARPU Rs 175 → Rs 190 YoY
triggers.quote: We also saw a healthy expansion in our Customer ARPU from Rs. 175 in Q4FY25 to Rs. 190 in Q4FY26, a growth of 8.3% YoY.

triggers.label: Cash EBITDA only +4.8% in FY26
triggers.quote: The cash EBITDA for this full year ended at Rs.9,217 Crores. It showed only Page 6 of 16 a marginal improvement

triggers.label: Subscriber base flat, Feb-26 net adds positive
triggers.quote: we have registered improvement in subscriber numbers, for the first-time post-merger in the month of February which has continued into March as well.

triggers.label: Capex only Rs 8,742 Cr vs Rs 9,600 Cr prior year
triggers.quote: we've spent Rs. 8,700 Crores in the last full year versus an Rs. 9,600 Crores of the previous year.

guidance.quote: we've maintained our capex for the over the next three years for Rs. 45,000 Crores
the cash EBITDA number will be north of 35%. We don't want to share in which year that will happen
our three-year targets are unambiguous: sustained net customer addition, double-digit revenue growth, and 3x EBITDA.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we've maintained our capex for the over the next three years for Rs. 45,000 Crores

red_flags.label: Profit inflated by AGR exceptional gain
red_flags.quote: we recorded a net profit of Rs. 51,970 Crores in Q4 FY 2026 and a net profit of Rs. 34,552 Crores for the full year of FY 2026.

red_flags.label: Funding for FY27-29 capex not yet closed
red_flags.quote: We don't want to put a timeline, unless and until its closed.

red_flags.label: Spectrum payouts Rs 27,000 Cr in FY29 needs debt and cash flow
red_flags.quote: Rs. 7,000 Crores, Rs. 15,000 Crores and Rs. 27,000 Crores is the spectrum I have to pay over next three years

evasions.quote: We don't want to put a timeline, unless and until its closed.
